content: {"findings":[{"file":"index.js","line":173,"severity":"minor","message":"The regex quantifier was changed from {2,} to {1,} for duplicate slash collapsing in the remnant processing. This is semantically incorrect (\"duplicate\" means 2 or more), though functionally equivalent in JavaScript since replacing a single slash with itself is a no-op.
